description: The bar chart compares the accuracy of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different datasets: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70, while the horizontal axis lists the datasets. For the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct dataset, MMAU has an accuracy of approximately 50%, and MMAR has an accuracy of about 30%. In the Audio-Reasoner dataset, MMAU shows a higher accuracy, close to 60%, whereas MMAR has an accuracy of around 40%. Lastly, for the Qwen-2.5-Omni dataset, both models exhibit similar performance, with MMAU and MMAR having accuracies near 60% and 50%, respectively. The bars are color-coded, with MMAU represented in blue and MMAR in purple. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
